messages:
maria: Quick sync — can we lock a 45–60m slot next week for the inference benchmarking readout? Need cross-team decisions on latency SLOs, cost tradeoffs, and the quantization rollback plan. Proposed agenda below and two slot options. @noah @jia @sara please react with availability.

maria: Agenda (rough):
- 5m quick status (what ran vs plan)
- 15m latency readout (p50/p95 curves + recent regressions)
- 10m cost/unit and throughput tradeoffs (batching quant profiles)
- 10m canary/rollback/runbook items (fallback models + autoscale)
- 10m action items + owners

maria: Slot options: Tue 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 16:00–17:00 PT. Prefer Tue if infra can prep dashboards.

noah: Tue works for me. Can we also add a short demo of the new prefix cache metrics? Want to show KV hit-rate impact on p95.

jia: Thu is tight for me but Tue morning is ok. I can pull latest cost-per-token numbers from billing. Will post a short table beforehand.

sara: +1 for Tue. I'll bring the canary runbook + the latest flamegraphs for the kernel path that regressed. Also want to flag one dataset where quantized 4-bit shows SNR drop.

maria: Great. @eng-sre-bot could you reserve a room and create a calendar invite for Tue 10–11 PT, include a Google Meet? Also please attach the perf dashboard link.

eng-sre-bot: Meeting created: Tue 10:00 PT — "Inference perf readout". Calendar invite sent to participants. Dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/perf/inference-readout (view-permission: eng-ml,eng-platform).

noah: I'll upload two snapshots to the thread before EOD Monday: 1) p95 latency by model+seq, 2) batch-size vs cost scatter. Files: `p95_snap_2026-03-15.csv`, `batch-cost-2026-03-15.png`.

jia: I'll add a short cost table and call out assumptions (GPU-hours, mem savings from q4->q8). Format: `model, q, tokens, $/k tokens`. Will pin.

maria: For the readout slides: keep it <=8 slides. Call out the regression root-candidates and at least one mitigation (config or model fallback). Please add a one-line owner for each action.

noah: Quick check — do we want external stakeholders (product/solutions) on for first 15m? They asked for summary.

maria: Good point. Let's invite product to first 10 minutes only. I'll put them as optional in the invite.

jia: FYI I spotted a discrepancy between the billing report and the trial run estimator. I'll include the diff and a note: `estimator overcounts by ~2% on long seqs` so cost numbers might shift slightly.

sara: One more ask — can we have a small demo of the fallback routing policy? I can mock the flow: `request -> model-A -> fallback model-B` with metrics showing latency delta. Need 5–7m.

maria: Perfect. Team actionables before Tue:
- noah: upload p95 and batch artifacts (by Mon EOD)
- jia: cost table + estimator diff (by Mon EOD)
- sara: prepare canary runbook + fallback demo (by Mon EOD)
- maria: finalize slides + invite product for first 10m (today)

noah: noted. Also, can we add a quick table in the invite with the exact models we will read out? My proposal: `redwood-llama-70b-q8`, `redwood-llama-70b-q4`, `eleuther-13b-q4`. Anyone object?

jia: Those are fine. Maybe add `gptx-4k-tuned` as a control for our latency baseline.

sara: fine with that. I'll ensure the flamegraph compares kernel hot paths across those.

maria: Thanks all — see you Tue. If anything blocks prepping materials, ping here. :thumbsup:

noah: Quick follow-up — putting links to the test harness: `git:/repos/infer-bench` and the run command we used:
```
./run_bench --model redwood-llama-70b-q4 --seq 2048 --batch 2 --quant q4
```
I'll include exact seed/config in the upload.

jia: Thanks. I'll reconcile cost after those artifacts land.

sara: Will do. If we find the SNR drop is unacceptable, propose we include a rollback play: pin q8 for 70b for traffic > X TPS. I'll draft thresholds.

maria: Awesome. Closing thread — invite sent; materials checklist above. If you can't make Tue, please propose a swap now.
